title: Study of a Combination SARS-CoV-2 Recombinant Spike and High-Dose Inactivated Influenza Vaccine with Matrix-M Adjuvant in Adult Participants 60 Years of Age and Older
official: A Phase 3, Parallel, Randomized, Modified Double-Blind, Active-Controlled, Multi-Arm Study to Assess the Safety and Immunogenicity of a Combination Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) Recombinant Spike and High-Dose Inactivated Influenza Vaccine with Matrix-M Adjuvant in Adult Participants 60 Years of Age and Older
summary:
Main objective: To demonstrate the non-inferiority in influenza-specific immune responses between the combination vaccine and the comparator arm for each of the 3 influenza vaccine strains, in a subset of participants
To demonstrate the non-inferiority in SARS-CoV-2 variant-specific immune responses between the combination vaccine and the comparator arm, in a subset of participants

interventions.name: Nuvaxovid dispersion for injection COVID-19 Vaccine (recombinant, adjuvanted)

Efluelda suspension for injection in pre-filled syringe
Trivalent influenza vaccine (split virion, inactivated), 60 micrograms HA/strain

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Screening Visit: Aged 60 years or older on the day of inclusion
2. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01): Able to attend all scheduled visits and to comply with all study procedures
3. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01): Participant must be able to receive an injection in the deltoid muscle of both arms
4. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01): Participant must have completed a primary vaccination series against SARS-CoV-2 and at least 1 booster with a locally authorized or approved COVID-19 vaccine
5. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Screening Visit: Informed consent form has been signed and dated
6. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Screening Visit: Able to attend all scheduled visits and to comply with all study procedures
7. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Screening Visit: Participant must be able to receive an injection in the deltoid muscle of both arms
8. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Screening Visit: Participant must have completed a primary vaccination series against SARS-CoV-2 and at least 1 booster with a locally authorized or approved COVID-19 vaccine
9. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01):  Aged 60 years or older on the day of inclusion
10. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01): Participants who are healthy or with pre-existing stable condition, as determined by medical evaluation including medical history and physical examination
11. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01): Non-childbearing potential (i.e., post-menopausal for at least 1 year or surgically sterile)
12. Inclusion criteria to be checked at Visit 1 (D01): lnformed consent form has been signed and dated
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known/suspected immunodeficiency; immunosuppressive therapy in past 6 months; long-term systemic corticosteroids
2. Prior history of myocarditis, pericarditis, or myopericarditis
3. Any vaccine given within 4 weeks before or within 4 weeks after study intervention
4. Previous vaccination against influenza (in the previous 6 months before study intervention) with an investigational or marketed vaccine OR history of influenza infection in the previous 6 months
5. Previous vaccination against COVID-19 (in the previous 6 months before study intervention) with an investigational or marketed vaccine OR history of COVID-19 infection in the previous 6 months
6. Has received a blood transfusion or blood-derived products, including immunoglobulins, in the past 3 months
7. Deprived of freedom by an administrative or court order, or being in an emergency setting, or hospitalized involuntarily
8. Is an investigator, investigator/study center employee, or immediate family member (parent, spouse, natural/adopted child) of the investigator/employee with direct involvement in the study
9. Known systemic hypersensitivity to any study intervention components or history of life-threatening reaction to study interventions or products with the same substances
10. Self-reported thrombocytopenia, contraindicating intramuscular injection, based on investigator’s judgment
11. Bleeding disorder, or receipt of anticoagulants in the 3 weeks preceding inclusion, contraindicating intramuscular injection, based on investigator’s judgment
12. Chronic illness that, in the opinion of the investigator, is at a stage where it might interfere with study conduct or completion
13. Moderate/severe acute illness/infection (per investigator judgment)/fever (≥38.0°C [≥100.4°F]) on study intervention day. Include participant only after the condition or fever has resolved.
14. Alcohol, prescription drug, or substance abuse that, in the opinion of the Investigator, might interfere with the study conduct or completion
15. History of serious adverse reaction to any influenza or COVID-19 vaccines per investigator’s judgment
16. Personal or family history of Guillain-Barré syndrome
